project: Smart Field Survey Device — PCB Presentation V4
pipeline: 4 real photos -> registration/board_map.json + board_mesh.json -> earcut-triangulated board meshes -> photo-derived textures -> level-A/B/C components -> photo-matched top-down renders -> IoU overlay validation

registration_inputs.board_map.json: traced outlines (476/230 pts), detected holes, edge notches, front/back homography validation
registration_inputs.board_mesh.json: earcut triangles for top/bottom caps + hole/slot rings; supersedes Blender curve tessellation which failed on self-touching traced contours
registration_inputs.registered_*.png: perspective-corrected top-down board images used for silkscreen/trace-shadow extraction

boards.outline: real traced contour, 476 points — wavy edge undulation, deep left/top notches, edge lobes
boards.holes: 2 large interior through-holes (front/back registered, 1.31mm mean offset) + 10 plated perimeter holes read from overlays (nudged inward to fit traced lobes; 2 unverifiable positions dropped) + right-centre kidney slot 14x8
boards.geometry: earcut triangulation: 781 cap triangles + wall quads; no boolean/curve-fill dependency

boards.outline: real traced contour, 230 points — chamfered corners, edge notches
boards.holes: 1 centre hole (detected) + 5 perimeter plated holes (overlay-read, nudged to fit)
boards.geometry: earcut triangulation: 408 cap triangles + wall quads

measured_from_registration: real silkscreen marks baked into TEX4_* (thin white connected components)
real trace-shadow luminance baked into TEX4_*
board green tone mottling from photo
overlay_read_manual: daughter/shield zone 28x40 at (1,-29), flush to bottom edge
wound silver coil dia16 inside zone bottom (1,-36)
vertical SN strip on zone left edge, text strip at zone base
7 JST connectors on B at measured positions/rotations
procedural_presentation: mid ICs / tantalum caps at plausible positions
ribbon cable + plug at right edge

validation.method: compare_v4.py — green-mask segmentation, scale+centre align, 50% overlay + IoU
validation.caveat: IoU is sensitive to render brightness and the single-scale alignment; right-edge drift ~2% comes from the pxmm assumption in registration, not a modelling error. Inspect validation/compare_*.png visually.

A perimeter hole (46,-30) — initial guess wrong, nudge collided with slot
